name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response 'Hola' was returned for the prompt 'Say hello in Spanish'.
deviations: The quickstart documentation specified model 'accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1', but that model returned a 404 Not Found error ('Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'). I had to query the Fireworks models API to find an available chat model and substituted 'accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash' instead. Everything else followed the quickstart exactly: used the OpenAI Python SDK, the same base_url, same API key env var, and same message format.

first_call.evidence: openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}, 'request_id': 'chatcmpl-c23671fbbcbf49468e1fdc5eecd88bbb'}

friction.detail: The docs specify model='accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1' but the API returns 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'.
Trying model='accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct' yields the same 404: 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'.
User had to run 'curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY" https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models | head -c 2000' because the quickstart docs do not mention this fallback.
API returns vague 404: 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed' without listing valid model IDs.
